question: 在同一个 current main student 与相同 paired innovations 下，固定 7 次 teacher correction 的 uniform 与 late schedule 是否减少 fully adaptive CEM 的累计搜索偏移？

cem.shared_innovations: same per pair and round across all four arms

fresh_evaluation.shared_pairing: same episode/anchor/action-prefix pair and same innovations across arms
fresh_evaluation.teacher_only_round1_std: population std of teacher costs on teacher-only round-1 300-candidate population, floor 1e-6
fresh_evaluation.secondary_probe: independent 300-candidate epsilon transform at each arm's round-30 post-update mu/sigma, shared within pair

metrics.primary_block: teacher_objective(post-update mu) minus teacher_objective(teacher-only post-update mu at same round), divided by that pair's teacher-only round-1 population std
metrics.primary_episode: mean over 3 anchors x 2 action-prefix seeds = 6 final round-30 observations; rounds 10/20 are diagnostics
metrics.schedule_comparison: uniform_teacher7 and late_teacher7 each minus student_only at round 30, paired per final observation; lower is better
metrics.uniform_late_comparison: uniform_teacher7 minus late_teacher7 at round 30; lower means uniform is better
reported: final first-action L2 drift vs teacher-only
metrics.timing: native wallclock around complete 30-round trajectory including candidate generation/H2D, scoring, top30, and mu/sigma update; CUDA synchronized

validity: all 48 paired trajectories and rounds complete
gates.overall: PASS if at least one eligible schedule passes both quality and latency gates; otherwise FAIL

execution.telemetry_process: direct nvidia-smi PID with cleanup trap

external_context_reference: Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026), Scientific Agent Skills, latest DOI https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065; method context only, not LeWM/PushT evidence
claim_boundary: This is fixed-observation fully adaptive CEM mechanism evidence. It does not establish official planner deployment, environment closed-loop success, or training improvement.
